package.name: threevn_hardware
package.description:
ros2_control hardware interface for the physical 3VN arm, and the wire protocol it speaks.
include/threevn_hardware/protocol.hpp is compiled into BOTH this package and the ESP32 firmware under firmware/esp32/, so the two cannot disagree about framing, field order or units. It has no dependencies - no ROS, no Arduino, no STL containers, no allocation - which is what lets it be tested natively with no hardware attached.
ARCHITECTURAL RULE: this package must never depend on Gazebo. It is the real-hardware leg of the seam; a simulator dependency here would mean deploying the simulator to the robot.
